Plan defect: status-projection's exact seven-field value conflicts with merged status renders pinned in unfenced tests (test_cli, test_verbs, test_drain, test_drain_upgrade), and the _status CLI caller sits outside the fence.

Plan defect: the status scorecard field needs retro.Window(events, now).projection(sha, spec_version), but status.project gets no clock, sha or spec_version, and squatch/retro.py is not in Context. Section 20 must name that source.

When re-authoring, phase5-continue-03 must embed tests/test_seeded_phase5_01.py, the immediately preceding merged seeded test. The phase4_05 fixture is an exception that applies only to phase5-continue-02.

The retro-doctor-cli fence must name exact existing test paths (checked on main), not 'their focused tests'. List embedded Context, named on-demand exceptions with byte sizes, and phase5-continue-04's exact Context and exclusions.
